title: KIA Drone/Artillery Strike Kills 5 Pro-Junta Militia at Danai Training Base
detail: The Kachin Independence Army (KIA) carried out a drone and artillery strike on August 9, 2026 against a training base of the pro-junta Min Zay Thant militia in Danai (Tanai) Township, Kachin State, killing 5 militia members and injuring 10 others during a military graduation ceremony.

media.caption: KIA drone and artillery strike hits a pro-junta Min Zay Thant militia base in Danai Township during a graduation ceremony.

title: Pro-Junta Militia Executes 4 Civilians in Hpakant Jade-Mining Hub in Retaliation
detail: In retaliation for the KIA's August 9, 2026 strike on their Danai training base, members of the pro-junta Min Zay Thant militia entered Nawngmyi village, Hpakant Township, Kachin State, dragged four young ethnic Kachin men — Ko Lamai Gwang Mai, Ko Dawng Lwan, Ko Htoi San Aung, and Ko Sut Aung — from their homes, and summarily executed them.

media.caption: Pro-junta militia executes 4 ethnic Kachin civilians in Nawngmyi village, Hpakant Township.
